title: We're registering workers across regional NSW
summary: Casual labouring, mining, disability support, community, transport and cleaning roles from Tamworth to the Hunter and Sydney. Here's what we're looking for.
body:
BrightSteps is registering workers for casual and ongoing shifts across the New England and North West, the Hunter and Sydney. Our new Jobs page lists each role we're currently hiring for, the towns it covers, and what you need to apply.

Who we're looking for

  • Labourers for construction, civil, agricultural and warehouse sites
  • Mining labourers for sites around Gunnedah, Narrabri and the Upper Hunter
  • Disability support workers for in-home, community access, respite and SIL shifts
  • Community support workers, drivers and cleaners for local programs

How to apply

Choose a role on the Jobs page and press Apply. The form takes about five minutes and it's free. We read every application and call you to talk about your skills, availability and the towns you can work in.

Don't see your role or town? Register anyway and we'll contact you when something suits.
